color: rgb(219, 228, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
0-5 min - STABILIZE
ABCs, O2, monitor, IV
FINGERSTICK GLUCOSE
Thiamine 100 mg BEFORE D50
START THE CLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(219, 228, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5-20 min - BENZODIAZEPINE
Lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg IV (max 4 mg/dose)
OR Midazolam 10 mg IM if no IV
OR Diazepam 0.15-0.2 mg/kg IV
MAY REPEAT ONCE

div.style: color: rgb(230, 223, 251) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(219, 228, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Load a maintenance ASM
Find the cause
cEEG if not waking up

div.style: color: rgb(248, 223, 227) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
20-40 min - ESTABLISHED SE
Pick ONE (ESETT: all equal, ~45-47%)
Levetiracetam 60 mg/kg (max 4500 mg)
Fosphenytoin 20 mg PE/kg (max 1500)
Valproate 40 mg/kg (max 3000 mg)

div.style: color: rgb(230, 223, 251) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 223, 227) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
40-60 min - REFRACTORY SE
INTUBATE + cEEG + a-line
Continuous IV anesthetic:
Midazolam 0.2 mg/kg load, 0.05-2 mg/kg/h
OR Propofol 1-2 mg/kg load, 20-200 mcg/kg/min
OR Pentobarbital 5-15 mg/kg, 0.5-5 mg/kg/h

div.style: color: rgb(248, 223, 227) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Titrate to cEEG:
seizure suppression or
BURST-SUPPRESSION
Hold 24-48 h, then wean

div.style: color: rgb(230, 223, 251) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Recurs on wean,
or >24 h of
anesthesia?

div.style: color: rgb(248, 223, 227) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SUPER-REFRACTORY SE
Ketamine (NMDA - the up-trafficked target)
Add ASM: lacosamide/topiramate/brivaracetam
Immunotherapy if NORSE/FIRES
Ketogenic diet, inhaled anesthetics
